categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC batch request handling in src/httprpc.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance bug where parsing errors on non-object batch elements inherit the preceding request's ID or get dropped if preceded by a notification. The PR description notes that for `[{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"getblockcount","id":"X"}, 2]`, master duplicates ID 'X' across replies or drops the error entirely if the first element was a notification. While it ensures response correctness, it affects edge-case malformed batch requests and is reasonably deferrable.
